subject: Course recommender web app using shiny

messages.author: 960c55224c97165a
messages.subject: Course recommender web app using shiny
parts: I am new to R language and Shiny app. I am planning on building a course recommender web application. Is it possible to use Shiny app for the same considering the large database of students and courses? A brief description of the web app is : Students should be able to fill in their details(field of interest, courses taken etc) and the web app should be able to give course recommendations for that student using appropriate algorithm.
